# Geelooy SEO Continuation Mission

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos renews every path from nothing each instant; this continuation treats the current repository as the only trustworthy vessel and verifies every search-facing claim anew on Awtsmoos.com.

## Mission

Complete server-visible indexing for public Geelooy content, especially Ikar Road/Heichel routes, while preserving interactive JavaScript behavior and avoiding crawler-only rendering.

## Non-negotiable evidence gates

1. Current HEAD and current working tree must be reconciled before any source write.
2. Numeric Road URLs must resolve real post data before template rendering.
3. Initial HTML must include real title, canonical URL, description, and Torah body without client JavaScript.
4. Heichel/series pages must expose ordinary crawlable public links.
5. Missing/private content must never be accidentally indexable.
6. Robots and sitemap discovery must use server-native responses and public data only.
7. A fresh isolated local server must prove source behavior independently of long-lived process caches.
8. Browser verification must prove client enhancement still works after server rendering.
9. Every touched source file must remain modular, tab-indented, documented, and below the project line ceiling.
10. Final completion requires re-reading the changed files and comparing planned versus actual behavior.
